reviews.title: ASUS Prime B760M-A-CSM. Excellent
reviews.comment: ASUS Prime B760M-A-CSM.  ASUS has not failed me yet.  Their manual needs a rework. Print is not small it is tiny and unclear. They really need to improve their documentation so more people can build their own without issues.  Being experienced, I am not bragging, I didn’t need the manual except for some reference and reassurance.
